name: Gequity S.p.A.
summary: Gequity S.p.A. is a real estate investment firm. The firm manages real estate funds of their acquired portfolio companies. It also engages in leasing activities. The firm was previously known as Centenari E Zinelli Spa. It was earlier into private equity and venture capital investments. Gequity S.p.A. was founded in 1907 and is based in Milan, Italy. As of May 22, 2017, Gequity S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of HRD Italia Srl.
